entities.summary: Mitchell Allan Scherr is an American record producer, singer, and songwriter best known as the frontman of the rock band SR-71. He rose to fame with the hit single "Right Now" (2000). He wrote the song "1985" for SR-71, which later became a massive platinum hit for Bowling for Soup.
